title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
shortDescription: Aging Solid Snake navigates war zones controlled by PMCs, using the OctoCamo suit to end the Patriots.
historicalSignificance: A tour de force of cinematic ambition and technical spectacle that drove PS3 console sales worldwide.
